description: [search] Search recordings and return ranked conversation_ids, typed hits, and the corresponding line_ids, segment_ids, memory_atom_ids, participant_ids, brief_ids, summary_ids, and action_item_ids. Transcript lines use language-specific token matching on indexed text, with keyword fallback when the index or tokenizer is unavailable. Topic segments, memory atoms, recording titles, and action items support both keyword and semantic search. Participant names and aliases, built-in recording briefs, and built-in recording summaries use keyword search. Use the available get_* tools to read more about a hit.

conversation_ids.description: Optional: restrict to these opaque recording ids.

query.description: Required. Pass a full phrase, or a JSON-encoded array of phrases for distinct facets. Put the main topic first. The first phrase uses keyword search and, for sources that support it, semantic search. Additional phrases use keyword search. Transcript tokenization is automatic.

search_types.description: Optional lane filter. Omit to search all. Allowed: transcript, segment, memory_atom, participant, title, brief, summary, action_item.

name: search_recordings

result.description: Tool-specific result payload; shape varies per tool (object for most; may be null/array/text for some). Intentionally type-unconstrained for strict-validating clients.
